double-bedroom-non-ac.name: Double Bedroom (Non-AC)
double-bedroom-non-ac.description: Comfortable, clean, budget-friendly double bedroom equipped with a ceiling fan and comfy bedding.
double-bedroom-non-ac.longDescription: Perfect for couples or budget-conscious solo travelers, the Double Bedroom (Non-AC) at Hotel Sunrise offers a clean, well-maintained, and comfortable base in Sri Vijaya Puram. It comes equipped with a ceiling fan, comfortable bedding, and a clean bathroom, offering maximum value for your stay.

features.title: Tactile Ceiling Fan
features.desc: Stay comfortable with a strong, quiet ceiling fan in your room.

features.title: Complimentary Toiletries
features.desc: Enjoy clean bathrooms equipped with organic soaps and premium toiletries updated daily.

double-bedroom-ac.name: Double Bedroom (AC)
double-bedroom-ac.description: Enjoy a cool and comfortable stay in our air-conditioned double bedrooms, equipped with modern split AC and ceiling fan.
double-bedroom-ac.longDescription: Ideal for couples or business travelers wanting cool comfort, the Double Bedroom (AC) features individual split air conditioning, custom wooden furnishings, and a modern clean bathroom to relax after exploring Sri Vijaya Puram.

features.title: Split Air Conditioning
features.desc: Relax in cool comfort with quiet split climate control in your room.

features.title: Complimentary Coffee & Tea
features.desc: Prepare hot beverages at your convenience with in-room electric kettles and supplies.

family-room-ac.name: Family Room (AC)
family-room-ac.description: Spacious air-conditioned family rooms with comfortable multiple bed setups, split AC, and excellent value for families.
family-room-ac.longDescription: Our spacious Family Room (AC) is designed to accommodate families or groups traveling together. Equipped with multiple comfortable beds, individual split air conditioning, a sitting area, and modern clean baths, it offers the perfect city base with easy access to markets and terminals.

features.title: Spacious Family Setup
features.desc: Designed with families in mind, providing ample space for children and luggage.

features.title: Complimentary Breakfast
features.desc: Start your island-hopping days with a hot, delicious breakfast for the whole family.
